subject: Azure Marketplace: publisher tenant sandbox provisioning + E2E tech playbook
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Support <azure-marketplace-support@microsoft.com>, Acme DevOps Team <acme-devops@example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace: publisher tenant sandbox provisioning + E2E tech playbook

Hi team,

We are preparing Acme Corp's publisher account for marketplace listing and need to provision a tenant sandbox for end-to-end validation. Goal: have a working sandbox with the offer registered, an identity-binding path for SPN, and one canonical test flow that exercises deployment, entitlement, and billing hooks.

As discussed on last week's sync, please confirm the earliest time you can provision a publisher sandbox tenant (subscription ID + publisher ID link) and any required evidence for identity proofing. Attached is our initial runbook (runbook-v1.pdf) and a provisioning script we intend to run in the tenant (tenant-provisioning-script.sh).

Primary asks:
- Required publisher account identifiers you need from Acme to complete provisioning
- Any specific Azure roles or SPN scopes to request for the sandbox agent
- Recommended canary test matrix size for offer publish (we propose 3 SKUs, see canary-test-matrix.xlsx)
- A short window for a joint test next week (30-60 min) to validate entitlement callbacks and usage reporting

Acme DevOps, please provide the publisher contact + preferred contact window (PDT preferred). Marissa/Aditya: I'll need a short checklist of Redwood-side items (tokens, asset bundle, telemetry hooks) to validate before the joint test.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: runbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB), tenant-provisioning-script.sh (shell script, 6KB)

From: Azure Marketplace Support <azure-marketplace-support@microsoft.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Acme DevOps Team <acme-devops@example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Apr 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: publisher tenant sandbox provisioning + E2E tech playbook

Hi Sofia and team,

Thanks for the runbook and script — that helps a lot. We can provision a sandbox tenant as early as Monday 21 Apr, but we need the following items from Acme to proceed:

1) Publisher ID (GUID) or email used for publisher enrollment
2) Target subscription ID for the sandbox or permission to create a sandbox subscription on their behalf
3) Owner contact (name + email) for the publisher account to complete automated identity checks

SPN/Role guidance:
- Please create a Service Principal with Contributor on the sandbox subscription and Owner on the resource group used for test deployments.
- If you want least-privilege, provide us with an SPN that has Microsoft.Resources/deployments/* and Microsoft.Marketplace/entitlements/* for the specific RG; we can validate during the test.

Canary sizing: 2-3 SKUs with a single region (we recommend US West 2) is sufficient for validation. For billing callbacks, ensure the developer telemetry includes a correlation_id header.

We'll tentatively book a 45-minute slot next Tuesday 22 Apr 11:00-11:45 PDT for the joint run, pending Acme confirmation. If you prefer the earlier Monday window, let us know.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Support
Marketplace Onboarding Team
attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Acme DevOps Team <acme-devops@example.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: publisher tenant sandbox provisioning + E2E tech playbook

Thanks Azure — good guidance. Quick notes from Redwood side:

Redwood pre-checks (we will complete before the joint run):
- Confirm model/offer asset bundle is uploaded to our staging S3 and signed
- Generate publisher API keys and test JWTs for entitlement callbacks
- Load the tenant-provisioning-script.sh in a staging runner and sanitize logs for PII

Proposed joint run agenda (45m):
- 0-5m: Introductions + objectives
- 5-15m: Tenant & SPN verification (Azure walks through permissions)
- 15-30m: Offer register + deployment of one SKU into test RG
- 30-40m: Trigger usage event and verify entitlement/billing callback
- 40-45m: Next steps and rollout checklist

Aditya: can you confirm we have a test JWT that includes the x-correlation-id header? If not, I'll generate one and drop it into the runbook.

Acme DevOps: please provide the publisher GUID and preferred slot (Mon 21 or Tue 22). If you need Redwood to create the SPN, we can do that during the run but will need Owner on the RG.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: canary-test-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Support <azure-marketplace-support@microsoft.com>, Acme DevOps Team <acme-devops@example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: publisher tenant sandbox provisioning + E2E tech playbook

Folks — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming the joint test for Tue, 22 Apr 2025 11:00-11:45 PDT. Acme provided the publisher GUID in a separate note: 6f3a2b8c-9d2b-4a1f-8a12-cc9d2e8b7f55.

Quick execution checklist (copying into the calendar invite):
- Acme: confirm subscription ID and grant Contributor/Owner as discussed
- Azure: provision the sandbox tenant and share the tenant link and subscription mapping
- Redwood (Marissa/Aditya): provide test JWTs, publish the staging asset, and be ready to run tenant-provisioning-script.sh
- All: join Teams link (https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/0/0?context=example) 5 minutes early for access checks

I'll upload a redacted runbook to the shared Drive and route the DocuSign link for the publisher agreement prior to the run: https://drive.redwood/example/runbook-v1
